concept: Use case: ui-mockup. Design one polished desktop screenshot of a connected defense edge-AI explainer, within a dark forest-green VSS app. It must be a spatial story, not a dashboard grid. Main content left 70%: beautifully detailed realistic architectural scale-model diorama of one small coastal military airfield on a dark seamless background. Hangar with transport plane at back right, damaged taxiway left, gate at foreground right, support truck foreground left, drone above taxiway. High oblique 3/4 perspective, coherent roads and realistic materials, elegant architectural visualization, no blocky map. One thin mint camera sightline connects drone to damage. A small photographic camera inset opens at lower right of the diorama showing broken pavement. Keep most of diorama visible. The same scene is meant to persist and zoom/pan between story steps. Right 30% editorial text: '01 / AIRFIELD RECOVERY', large headline 'Start with the place. Follow the camera.', paragraph 'The drone surveys the pavement. Its video reaches Anvil at the ground station.', small outcome 'Next: inspect the finding'. Top quiet nav: Overview, Airfield, Site watch, Vehicle, Why Anvil. Bottom thin flow band with camera icon, 'Drone camera', arrow, 'Anvil-T5 / Ground station', arrow, 'Finding + source image'. Footer steps 01 / 09 and Next step. Professional spacious typography, warm ivory text, muted sage captions, mint fine overlays and amber finding pin. No neon, no fake stats, no satellite UI, no stock cards. One visually connected scene with code-native UI intended. Match background #101715 and panel #1c261f. This is the main explainer surface, exclude app sidebar from this concept because existing app sidebar will remain unchanged. Full 16:9 screen, all elements readable.
asset: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone production background asset of the detailed architectural airfield diorama in the reference. NO interface, NO text, NO lines, NO markers, NO inset frames, NO typography. The entire 16:9 image is the coherent diorama, showing its whole sculpted island base with generous dark forest green #101715 surrounding it. Beautifully realistic physical scale model, high oblique three-quarter perspective. Coastal rock terrain, damaged taxiway at center-left (x38%, y48%), large open hangar and one recognizable military transport plane at back-right (x72%, y35%), fenced service gate at foreground-right (x71%, y65%), one military support truck on the service road at foreground-left (x31%, y68%), small camera mast near gate, one small QUADCOPTER above taxiway at x28%, y27% (not fixed-wing combat drone), small ground-station shelter near mid-left. These locations need to be visually distinct with space around them for later code-native annotations. Warm directional dawn light, detailed real-world materials, tarmac markings, realistic miniature trees, understated illuminated hangar. Frame the whole airfield island without cropping its edges. Large subject fills 90% width, coherent geometry. Match reference scene realism and sophisticated dark integration. No weapons, no explosions, no abstract blocks, no floating software panels.
